petstore-api$ vendor/bin/php-sdk generate
petstore-api$ cat contracts/generated.yaml
# Generated by bidirekt/php-sdk. Do not edit.
provides:
  rest:
    /pets:
      get:
        responses:
          200: PetList
      post:
        request: NewPet
        responses:
          201: Pet
          422: ~
    /pets/*:
      get:
        responses:
          200: Pet
          404: ~
schemas:
  NewPet:
    type: object
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
      birthDate:
        type: string
        optional: true
        nullable: true
  Pet:
    type: object
    properties:
      id:
        type: integer
      name:
        type: string
      status:
        ref: PetStatus
      birthDate:
        type: string
        nullable: true
        description: ISO 8601 date
  PetList:
    type: array
    items:
      ref: Pet
  PetStatus:
    type: enum
    members: ["available", "pending", "sold"]
petstore-api$ bidirekt create-participant petstore_api
Broker: http://localhost:8080 (from BIDIREKT_BROKER_URL)
petstore_api participant created
petstore-api$ bidirekt validate contracts/generated.yaml --participant petstore_api --environment production
Broker: http://localhost:8080 (from BIDIREKT_BROKER_URL)
petstore_api local contract can be deployed to production
nothing deployed in production to compare with
petstore-api$ bidirekt publish contracts/generated.yaml --participant petstore_api --version 1
Broker: http://localhost:8080 (from BIDIREKT_BROKER_URL)
petstore_api contract publish successful
petstore-api$ bidirekt can-i-deploy petstore_api --version 1 --environment production
Broker: http://localhost:8080 (from BIDIREKT_BROKER_URL)
petstore_api 1 can be deployed to production
nothing deployed in production to compare with
petstore-api$ bidirekt record-deployment petstore_api --version 1 --environment production
Broker: http://localhost:8080 (from BIDIREKT_BROKER_URL)
petstore_api deployment recorded to production
storefront$ vendor/bin/php-sdk generate
storefront$ cat contracts/generated.yaml
# Generated by bidirekt/php-sdk. Do not edit.
consumes:
  petstore_api:
    rest:
      /pets:
        get:
          responses:
            200: PetList
      /pets/*:
        get:
          responses:
            200: Pet
            404: ~
schemas:
  Pet:
    type: object
    properties:
      id:
        type: integer
      name:
        type: string
      status:
        type: string
  PetList:
    type: array
    items:
      ref: Pet
